cipher.seams: none — this change touches `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/`, `docs/` and the run log only. No contract, mock, adapter, fixture or seam test is modified, and `npm run chamber:lock` reports all 38 seams ok before and after.
cipher.summary: Moved the evidence checks out of an untracked session script into the repository, then hardened them across eleven review rounds against reproduced defeats: a transcript whose result came from its own stdout, an appended retry inheriting an earlier pass, an entire consistent run replayed under a new date, a config override described but never shown, an artifact omitted from the tape treated as current, and a same-length edit to a chain artifact.
cipher.risks: The guard reads text produced by tools it does not control, so a reporter format change can make it reject valid evidence — three such false rejections were found and fixed during review, including CRLF transcripts and Windows-written `evidenceDir` paths. Two SonarCloud issues on this branch remain unidentified because sonarcloud.io is unreachable from the capture environment; `sonarjs.configs.recommended` is clean on the file and the differential all-rules scan shows no new rule class, so the remaining candidate is `.github/workflows/verify.yml`. Recorded rather than guessed at.
